200.description:
Read one Alternate NL product by article number or product URL: name, brand, manufacturer part number, EAN, EUR price and struck reference price, schema.org availability with the shown stock and delivery texts, breadcrumb categories, description, image, rating and the full specification table.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article_number` | string | Alternate article number. |
| `availability` | string | schema.org availability of the offer: InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, ... |
| `brand` | string | Brand. |
| `categories` | string[] | Breadcrumb path from the top category down, without Home and the product itself. |
| `category` | string | Product type category. |
| `country` | string | Market of the storefront: always NL. |
| `currency` | string | Currency of every price: always EUR. |
| `delivery_text` | string | Dispatch promise under the stock text, e.g. 'voor 22:00 uur besteld, vandaag verzonden'; null when none is shown. |
| `description` | string | Marketing description (Dutch). |
| `ean` | string | EAN/GTIN barcode as published (schema.org gtin field, else the 'EAN' spec). |
| `image_url` | string | Main 600x600 image. |
| `in_stock` | boolean | True when the offer is InStock. |
| `language` | string | Storefront language: always nl (texts are Dutch as the site shows them). |
| `list_price` | number | Struck-through reference price in EUR (best price of the last 30 days); null without a discount. |
| `manufacturer_part_number` | string | Manufacturer part number (schema.org mpn, else the 'Fabrikantcode' spec). |
| `name` | string | Product name without the brand. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the page was read. |
| `price` | number | Current price in EUR including VAT; null when the page publishes no offer. |
| `rating` | number | Average customer rating out of 5; null without reviews. |
| `rating_count` | number | Number of customer ratings; null without reviews. |
| `specs` | object[] | The specification table in page order. |
| `stock_text` | string | Stock text as shown, e.g. 'Op voorraad' or 'Na bestelling binnen 6 werkdagen op voorraad (1 Beschikbaar)'. |
| `subtitle` | string | Variant or key-spec line under the title, without its parentheses. |
| `url` | string | Canonical product page. |

page.description:
Result page, 24 products per page; pass the previous next_page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 1.

query.description: Search terms, Dutch or English, a brand, model, EAN or manufacturer part number. An exact article number returns that one product.

200.description:
Search the Alternate NL catalogue by keyword and return one page of 24 products: article number, name, brand, EUR price and struck reference price, stock/delivery text, rating and rating count, key-spec bullets and URL, with the total count and the next page input. An exact article number returns that single product. Blocked pages raise an error.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article_number` | string | Alternate article number (Art-Nr.), the key of the product function. |
| `availability` | string | Stock and delivery text as shown, e.g. 'Op voorraad', 'Na bestelling binnen 6 werkdagen op voorraad', 'Niet op voorraad, geen informatie beschikbaar'. |
| `brand` | string | Brand shown in front of the name. |
| `highlights` | string[] | Key-spec bullets of the card ('Capaciteit: 1 TB'). |
| `image_url` | string | 200x200 listing image. |
| `in_stock` | boolean | True when the availability text is 'Op voorraad' (ships now); backorder and out-of-stock texts are false. |
| `list_price` | number | Struck-through reference price in EUR (the site labels it the best price of the last 30 days); null without a discount. |
| `name` | string | Product name without the brand, as on the card. |
| `price` | number | Current price in EUR including VAT. |
| `rating` | number | Average customer rating out of 5; null when the product has no reviews. |
| `rating_count` | number | Number of customer reviews; null when there are none. |
| `subtitle` | string | Short variant or key-spec line under the name (manufacturer code, colour, configuration). |
| `url` | string | Canonical product page. |
